title: Phone: menu sheet and a Needs you page across projects
text: On the phone, the menu opens as a full-height sheet with Needs you and your projects, and tapping a project switches the whole view to it. The bell opens a Needs you page that gathers what waits in every project, each entry naming its project and offering one-tap replies. Opening a card from another project switches the top bar to it; browser Back returns to the page and the card's cross lands on that project's list.
